usage: kathara lconfig [-h] [-d LAB_PATH] -n DEVICE_NAME
                       (--add CD/MAC [CD/MAC ...] | --rm CD [CD ...])

Manage the network interfaces of a running Kathara device in a Kathara network
scenario

options:
  -h, --help            Show a help message and exit.
  -d, --directory LAB_PATH
                        Path of the network scenario to configure, if not
                        specified the current path is used
  -n, --name DEVICE_NAME
                        Name of the device to configure.
  --add CD/MAC [CD/MAC ...]
                        Specify the collision domain to add.
  --rm CD [CD ...]      Specify the collision domain to remove.

For examples and further information visit:
https://github.com/KatharaFramework/Kathara/wiki
